calibration_scope: Executed independent two-hop service-model identification; configured operational-stage labels, modeled CPU/communication, and separately executed synthetic integer signal probes. No physical-board data, uniform true-process coverage, or deployment certification.
cpu_model: Assumed source encryption/compression/ticket-verification/tag/block-MAC times, successful gateway-envelope MAC verification and aggregation, sink ticket/HVE verification. Not full-protocol CPU: signing, provisioning, incomplete-envelope verification, OS/interrupts, and management are unmodeled. No MCU performance claim. Source encryption 0.004s is a declared k=3 to k=6 matrix-operation proxy (k^2:9 to 36), not measured cost; the no-IntDb2 path uses two ciphertexts and twice this proxy. Other timings remain independent assumptions.

decoding_probability_summary.finite_adaptive_union_scope: one choice from the finite declared profile/size library before fresh batch noise; joint random-key/history probability, not conditional on observed history or any fixed key
decoding_probability_summary.probability_scope: joint probability over independently sampled random keygen coefficients and fresh honest encryption noises for one batch; not a worst-case bound conditioned on every fixed realized secret key

description: Independent synthetic two-hop 802.15.4-style discrete-event experiment. Not OMNeT++/INET, not original unpublished source, not hardware calibration, not manuscript-result reproduction. Values are explicit modeling assumptions, not fitted to paper outcomes.

encryption_timing_proxy.scope: Quadratic matrix-operation-count proxy only; assumes fixed ring degree and linear time per matrix product. This is not a measured encryption time, full operation count, MCU benchmark, or hardware cost binding.

roster_policy: At each control-window start, the sink preauthorizes immutable gateway/path rosters from the public sampling plan and the current action/rho; final partial groups are frozen upfront with size <= selected maximum N. All sources and the aggregate use the same whole-roster ticket. Any missing/expired member rejects its entire authorized batch; rosters are never shrunk after reception. The same fixed-roster service rule is modeled for lightweight traffic without asserting its cryptographic security.

security_estimator_summary.scope: heuristic generic flattened-LWE estimates; not a module-specific, side-channel, implementation or worst-case proof

ticket_wire_model: Every source envelope and its aggregate carry the SAME whole-roster ticket: signature 2420B + assumed binary fixed fields 128B + identifier/nonce 20B per authorized member. The ticket is preauthorized at the control-window start; it is not dynamically signed after observing arrivals. Advance sink-to-source distribution, signing CPU, caches, and their retransmissions are not modeled. Inline source/aggregate envelope transmission includes the complete configured ticket bytes.
